description: Use this when the connected learner asks how they did on sprints, practice exams, the baseline or the final assessment. Returns each completed one by its CertArc name with Take 1 and Take 2 scores (mode, correct, percent, date), the current composite, after a retake the movement (Breakthroughs, Persisted, Regressions, net change) and mastery, sessions in progress with answered counts, and what the Final Readiness Assessment still needs before it unlocks. Scores only; never questions.

program.description: Certification to read. Omit for the one the learner studied most recently; every result names its certification and lists the learner's others.

title: Sprint and exam results
